title: Xbox Nano Controller: Xbox's smallest pad is $49.99 🎮
subject: xbox
description:
Would you use a controller this small? 👇

Microsoft revealed the Xbox Nano Controller on October 14, 2026: a little over 5 inches long, 3.5 ounces, with all 18 standard inputs plus a programmable Action Button and a rechargeable battery. It costs $49.99, pre-orders are open in 36 countries, and it ships in November. It connects over Xbox Wireless and Bluetooth.

Sources: Xbox Wire (Oct 14, 2026), Windows Central (Oct 14, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 14, 2026)

scenes.text: Xbox just revealed its smallest controller ever.
The Xbox Nano Controller is just over 5 inches long and weighs 3.5 ounces.
It still has all 18 standard inputs, plus a programmable Action Button for screenshots and clips.
At $49.99, it's about $15 cheaper than a standard Xbox controller.
Pre-orders opened October 14 in 36 countries, and it ships in November.
It pairs with Xbox consoles, and with PCs, phones and select smart TVs over Bluetooth.
